title_sq: Studio Luksoze per Shitje ne Astir!
description_sq:
Astiri eshte zone shume e kerkuar si per banim dhe per investim, duke qene se ka cdo sherbim dhe lehtesi qe i nevojitet perditshmerise. Gjithashtu ka akses te menjehershem me Unazen e madhe, e cila lidhet me zonat kryesore te Tiranes.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje ndertim te vitit 2010, ne krah te rreth-rrotullimit tek Ozone. Pozicionohet ne katin e 9 te pallatit dhe ka siperfaqe totale 42m². Organizohet si studio e ndare ne ambientin e fjetjes dhe ndenjes, nje tualet dhe ballkon. Orientimi Jug. Jane bere restaurime ne instalime hidraulike & elektrike, vetrata te reja me dopio xham dhe grila elektrike, sistem kapot dhe mobilim i bere me arkitekt.
Shitet si ne foto. Eshte e dhene me qira me kontrate 1 vjecare.
Per me teper informacion apo nje vizite ne prone ju ftoj te kontaktoni!
title_en: Luxury Studio for Sale in Astir!
description_en: Astiri is a highly sought-after area both for residence and investment, since it has every service and convenience needed for everyday life. It also has immediate access to the Great Ring, which connects to the main areas of Tirana. The apartment is located in a building built in 2010, next to the Ozone roundabout. It is located on the 9th floor of the building and has a total area of ​​42m². It is organized as a separate studio in the sleeping and living area, a toilet and a balcony. Orientation South. Plumbing & electrical installations have been restored, new windows with double glazing and electric shutters, bonnet system and furniture made by an architect. Sold as in the photo. It is rented with a 1-year contract. For more information or a visit to the property, I invite you to contact me!
